description: This file defines a Python class 'RecommendationRepository' for managing CRUD operations related to 'recommendations' in a database, including methods to create recommendations and retrieve lists based on analysis IDs, with or without related job details.

classes.name: RecommendationRepository
classes.description: A repository class providing asynchronous database operations related to recommendations, extending 'BaseRepository'.

methods.name: int create(self, analysis_id: int, job_id: int, score: float)
methods.description: Creates a new recommendation record in the database with given analysis, job, and score, returning the new record's ID.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recommendations for a specific analysis ID, ordered by score descending.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_analysis_with_jobs( self, analysis_id: int, limit: int, offset: int )
methods.description: Retrieves recommendations along with associated job details for a specific analysis ID, with pagination support (limit and offset).

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create(self, analysis_id: int, job_id: int, score: float) -> int:$/
ctags.signature: (self, analysis_id: int, job_id: int, score: float)

ctags.name: list_by_analysis
ctags.pattern: /^    async def list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: int) -> List[dict]:$/

ctags.name: list_by_analysis_with_jobs
ctags.signature: ( self, analysis_id: int, limit: int, offset: int )
